integrity: Proof-based infinite statements with a supplementary exact-arithmetic verifier; no claim of independent certification, global optimum, or authorship by external researchers.
scientific_limitations: Joint densities are proved only for indices 2 and 3 when h is unrestricted; full all-index counting distribution is proved precisely for the characterized one-step-rigid h. title: Exact two-stage square-defect spectrum and one-step rigidity for reciprocal-sum sequences
